summary: Eye shape, tilt, hooding, brow ridge and under-eye support define the 'hunter eye' ideal. Approaches range from surgery (canthoplasty, blepharoplasty) and injectables to makeup, brow work, lash products and forum-developed techniques.

approaches.name: Canthal tilt theory
approaches.why: Framework that upward-slanting outer eye corners read as attractive

approaches.name: Hunter eyes
approaches.why: Deep-set, hooded, slightly tilted eye look; target aesthetic

approaches.name: Hunter eyes surgery (hunter eyes canthopexy)
approaches.why: Surgery to tighten/tilt the canthus and lower lid for a hunter look

approaches.name: Lateral canthoplasty (canthoplasty)
approaches.why: Surgical reshaping/lengthening of the outer eye corner

approaches.name: Blepharoplasty (eyelid surgery)
approaches.why: Removes excess upper or lower eyelid skin/fat

approaches.name: Orbital decompression
approaches.why: Thyroid-eye surgery repurposed to set eyes deeper

approaches.name: Brow lift / brow bone augmentation (frontal bossing, forehead reduction)
approaches.why: Raises brows or builds a stronger supraorbital ridge

approaches.name: Fox eye thread lift (fox eyes)
approaches.why: PDO threads pull outer corners up for a tilted look

approaches.name: Under-eye filler (tear trough)
approaches.why: HA filler to smooth hollows and support the lower lid

approaches.name: Orbital rubbing / eye socket massage (orbital rubbing)
approaches.why: Claimed to reshape the orbit and tilt through pressure

approaches.name: Squintmaxxing
approaches.why: Habitual squinting to simulate hunter eyes in photos

approaches.name: Eyebrow transplant
approaches.why: Hair grafts to thicken or reshape sparse brows

approaches.name: Botulinum toxin A (Botox)
approaches.why: Chemical brow lift and glabellar relaxation

approaches.name: Minoxidil (Rogaine)
approaches.why: Topical minoxidil applied to thin eyebrows

approaches.name: Hyaluronic acid filler (Juvederm, Restylane)
approaches.why: HA used for brow bone, temples, infraorbital rim

approaches.name: Cheek implants
approaches.why: Adds midface support to lift/lean lower lids

approaches.name: LeFort 1 maxillary advancement (LeFort, maxilla advancement)
approaches.why: Midface advancement for infraorbital support, less scleral show

approaches.name: Mewing (orthotropics, tongue posture)
approaches.why: Tongue posture claimed to forward the maxilla and lift eyes

approaches.name: Brow lamination kit
approaches.why: Chemical straightening to shape and tilt brows

approaches.name: Brow tweezers + scissors
approaches.why: Tweezing/trimming brows to change eye frame

approaches.name: Eyebrow pencil / powder
approaches.why: Fills and angles brows for tilt

approaches.name: Eye massage device (Foreo Iris)
approaches.why: Vibrating device for puffiness and circles

approaches.name: Concealer (for men)
approaches.why: Hides dark circles that spoil eye area

approaches.name: Facial yoga / face exercises
approaches.why: Eye-area exercises claimed to lift lids

approaches.name: Extreme dieting / low body fat
approaches.why: Leaning out to reveal orbital and brow structure

approaches.name: Canthopexy
approaches.why: Tightens lower lid tendon without cutting the corner

approaches.name: Tarsal strip procedure
approaches.why: Tightens a lax lower lid to fix sagging and scleral show

approaches.name: Medial epicanthoplasty
approaches.why: Removes inner corner fold to open the eye

approaches.name: Non-incisional double eyelid (suture method)
approaches.why: Stitches create a crease without cutting

approaches.name: Ptosis surgery (levator advancement)
approaches.why: Lifts a drooping upper lid for a more open eye

approaches.name: Oxymetazoline eye drops (Upneeq)
approaches.why: Prescription drops that briefly lift mild ptosis

approaches.name: Eyelid tape / fold stickers
approaches.why: Sticky strips used to create an upper lid crease or hood lift

approaches.name: Eyelid glue
approaches.why: Adhesive to create temporary eyelid crease

approaches.name: Canthal tilt tape (lateral eye lift tape)
approaches.why: Tape pulled to the temple for tilted outer corners

approaches.name: Winged eyeliner for tilt
approaches.why: Liner extended upward to create the look of positive canthal tilt

approaches.name: Tightlining / waterline liner
approaches.why: Darkens lash line to make eyes look defined and deeper-set

approaches.name: Castor oil on brows/lashes
approaches.why: Traditional remedy used for thicker brows and lashes

approaches.name: Eyebrow microblading
approaches.why: Semi-permanent pigment strokes to reshape brows

approaches.name: Henna brows
approaches.why: Plant dye stain on brow skin and hair

approaches.name: Brow shaving / brow reshaping for tilt
approaches.why: Trimming brows to angle the eye area

approaches.name: Brow thread lift
approaches.why: Threads to elevate the brow tail

approaches.name: Infraorbital rim / zygomatic filler
approaches.why: Filler building skeletal support under the eye

approaches.name: PRP under eyes
approaches.why: Platelet-rich plasma to improve thin under-eye skin

approaches.name: Plasma pen blepharoplasty
approaches.why: Plasma shrinks eyelid skin; scarring risk

approaches.name: Polynucleotide eye filler
approaches.why: Polynucleotide injections for thin periorbital skin

approaches.name: Retinol
approaches.why: Retinoid eye creams for thin skin

approaches.name: Vitamin K eye cream
approaches.why: Used for dark circles with vascular component

approaches.name: Sleeping position for face symmetry (sleep posture)
approaches.why: Back sleeping to avoid one-sided facial pressure

approaches.name: Dermal rollers / microneedling eyes
approaches.why: Needling to thicken delicate eye skin

approaches.name: Bates method eye exercises
approaches.why: Eye exercises claimed to change eye shape/vision

approaches.name: Hair bangs / frame hairstyle for eyes
approaches.why: Hairstyle trick to frame brow and eye area

approaches.name: Eye whitening and brightening
approaches.why: Cross-reference: reduce redness for fresher look

summary: Nose size, hump, tip and width. Rhinoplasty is the standard clinical approach; non-surgical fillers and devices, and forum techniques such as bone-pushing and clips, are also discussed.

approaches.name: Rhinoplasty (nose job)
approaches.why: Surgical reshaping of nasal bone and cartilage

approaches.name: Nose reshaping clip
approaches.why: Silicone clips claimed to narrow or lift the nose

approaches.name: Nose bone massaging / nasal bone pushing
Nasal breathing meta
approaches.why: Breathing through nose claimed to improve facial structure

approaches.name: Chin implant / genioplasty (sliding genioplasty, chin extension)
approaches.why: Chin projection makes the nose look smaller

approaches.name: Medical tourism (Turkey/Istanbul/Korea) (Turkey trip)
approaches.why: Rhinoplasty abroad, often at lower prices than home countries

approaches.name: Black-market / DIY fillers (self-injected filler)
approaches.why: Self-injected filler near the nose risks blindness/necrosis

approaches.name: Bonesmashing (bone smashing, face hammering)
approaches.why: Hitting the face to reshape bone

approaches.name: Non-surgical rhinoplasty (liquid nose job)
approaches.why: Filler to smooth hump and lift tip

approaches.name: Turbinate reduction
approaches.why: Reduces swollen turbinates to improve breathing

approaches.name: Preservation rhinoplasty
approaches.why: Keeps dorsal structure while lowering hump

approaches.name: Rib cartilage graft rhinoplasty
approaches.why: Uses rib cartilage for structural support

approaches.name: Silicone/Gore-Tex nasal implant
approaches.why: Raises low bridge with alloplastic implant

approaches.name: Septal extension graft
approaches.why: Lengthens or rotates the nose tip

approaches.name: PDO nose thread lift
approaches.why: Threads to raise bridge and tip

approaches.name: Botox nose tip lift
approaches.why: Relaxes depressor muscle to lift droopy tip

approaches.name: Nose contouring makeup
approaches.why: Shading to visually slim the nose

approaches.name: Nose-lifting or slimming massage
approaches.why: Daily rubbing claimed to slim nose

approaches.name: Nose exercises (nose yoga)
approaches.why: Muscle exercises for nostril or tip shape

approaches.name: Isotretinoin (Accutane)
approaches.why: Used for rhinophyma and oily nasal skin

approaches.name: Azelaic acid
approaches.why: Reduces redness of nose from rosacea

approaches.name: Dorsal hump rasping (DIY)
approaches.why: Home filing or hitting of nasal bump

approaches.name: LeFort 1 maxillary advancement (LeFort, maxilla advancement)
approaches.why: Midface advancement changes nasal projection/tip rotation

approaches.name: Nasal irrigation
approaches.why: Clear congestion that distorts nose look

summary: Lip volume, definition, color and shape. Filler is the most common clinical option, alongside lip lifts, implants, topical plumpers, tattoo or blush, home suction devices and care routines.

approaches.name: Lip plumping device
approaches.why: Suction tools to swell lips temporarily

approaches.name: Facial yoga / face exercises
approaches.why: Lip muscle workouts claimed to plump

approaches.name: Hydroquinone
approaches.why: Used on dark lips; irritation risk

approaches.name: Clear aligners
approaches.why: Changes lip support through tooth position

approaches.name: Lip flip (Botox)
approaches.why: Relaxes orbicularis oris to roll lip up

approaches.name: Lip lift (bullhorn / subnasal)
approaches.why: Shortens philtrum and shows more upper lip

approaches.name: Fat grafting lips
approaches.why: Permanent lip volume via own fat

approaches.name: V-Y advancement / vermilion advancement
approaches.why: Surgery that increases pink lip show

approaches.name: Lip liner overlining
approaches.why: Liner drawn outside the lip line to create the look of larger lips

approaches.name: Lip hydration / water intake
approaches.why: Drinking water and humidifying for lip texture

approaches.name: Philtrum filler / shortening
approaches.why: Shapes the philtrum and cupid's bow

approaches.name: Honey and beetroot lip remedies
approaches.why: Traditional home remedies used for lip color

approaches.name: Lip stencil / bone structure hack: orthotropics for lip support
approaches.why: Mewing claimed to change lip profile

summary: Facial asymmetry is attributed to the jaw, soft tissue, skull, teeth, posture and sleep habits. Approaches include surgery, injectables, orthodontics and forum-developed habit-correction practices.

approaches.name: Sleeping position for face symmetry (sleep posture)
approaches.why: Back sleeping to avoid one-sided facial pressure

approaches.name: Chin implant / genioplasty (sliding genioplasty, chin extension)
Craniosacral therapy
approaches.why: Manual skull manipulation; reviews have found no evidence of benefit for facial structure

approaches.name: Myofascial release / Rolfing
approaches.why: Fascia work claimed to balance face

approaches.name: Frenotomy / tongue tie release for face

summary: Changing iris color and achieving whiter, brighter eyes. Options include colored lenses, surgery, eye drops, redness relievers, lid hygiene and makeup, alongside a range of unverified claims.

approaches.name: Eye color change surgery (keratopigmentation / iris implants) (BrightOcular, eye color surgery)
approaches.why: Corneal tattoo or iris implants; high blindness risk

approaches.name: Eye color change drops
approaches.why: Drops marketed as permanently changing eye color; no published evidence supports this

approaches.name: Sungazing
approaches.why: Claimed to improve eyes; damages retina

approaches.name: Colloidal silver
approaches.why: Silver suspension; regulators warn of argyria and other harms

approaches.name: Laser iris depigmentation (Stroma laser)
approaches.why: Laser removes iris pigment; glaucoma risk

approaches.name: Hypnosis for eye color change
approaches.why: Claimed to change iris color; no published evidence supports this

approaches.name: Honey drops in eyes
approaches.why: Traditional practice claimed to lighten eyes

approaches.name: Eye color meditation / visualization
approaches.why: Claimed to change iris color; no published evidence supports this

approaches.name: Reducing alcohol and salt for eye redness
Hydration and sleep for eye whites
Castor oil eye drops
approaches.why: Traditional practice used for eye comfort or brightness

approaches.name: Dark eyeliner to make iris pop
Warm / cool light & colored backgrounds for photos
Eye makeup remover & sleep for dark circles
